messages:
acme-ci: Hey support — after switching to the 'CI deploy' token we generated from the Dashboard, all API calls to https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat return 401 invalid_api_key. The token works in the dashboard "Try in Console" panel but curl gets 401.

acme-ci: ```bash
curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-deploy-XXXX" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"gpt-rl","input":"hi"}' \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat
```

acme-ci: Response:
HTTP/1.1 401 Unauthorized
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "error": "invalid_api_key",
  "message": "API key not valid for this endpoint"
}

maria-support: Thanks — can you paste the exact key id prefix (first 6 chars)? Also did you generate it under Org -> Settings -> Deploy tokens or under API keys?

developer: first6: sk-dep
we generated from Settings > Deploy tokens (label: 'ci-deploy')

devin-eng: Huh, we recently introduced dashboard-scoped tokens for UI-only operations (console test, dashboard deploy hooks). Those tokens are intentionally not usable against public API endpoints. They silently return invalid_api_key for security.

acme-ci: Oh wow. Not clear in the UI that there are two distinct token types.

maria-support: Agreed — sorry about the confusion. Quick repro: tokens created from Settings > Deploy tokens are 'dashboard-scoped'. Please create a key via Dashboard > API keys > Create new API key -> choose 'Service / CI' scope. That key will work for curl.

devin-eng: For immediate workaround we can issue a one-off API key for you. @sre-oncall can you approve a short-lived API key for org-acme (valid 24h) while they rotate to a proper CI key?

sre-oncall: Approved. Generated sk-temp-ABC123 (DMed). Let us know when you validate.

acme-ci: Verified — using sk-temp-ABC123 the curl succeeds. 200 OK. :white_check_mark: Thanks!

maria-support: We'll follow up to update the Deploy Tokens UI text. Escalating to UX to add explicit tooltip. Ticket #SUP-4421.

devin-eng: Adding note in docs: 'Deploy tokens are for dashboard/webhook use only — use API keys for server-side requests.'

acme-ci: Thanks all. Closing on our side after rotation.
